question: Select the synonym of **Amiable.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Friendly)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"amiable"** means having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner. (मिलनसार, सौम्य)

 
 
• **Example:** She greeted everyone with an amiable smile, making them feel welcome.
 
 
 
• **"Friendly"** refers to someone who acts in a kind, supportive, and warm manner. (दोस्ताना)
 
 
• **Example:** The friendly dog wagged its tail and approached the children eagerly.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'amiable'** is **'friendly'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Friendly)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rude** (असभ्य): Lacking courtesy or manners; being impolite.

 
 
• **Example:** His rude behavior offended everyone at the dinner table.
 
 
 
• **Hostile** (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Showing or feeling opposition or dislike; unfriendly.
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers encountered a hostile crowd in the occupied city.
 
 
 
• **Cold** (ठंडा): Lacking in warmth, emotion, or friendliness.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave him a cold stare and walked away without saying a word.
